title: Allow linking more than one Bluetooth glucose meter
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
If a user has more than 1 Bluetooth glucose meter, they have to scan every time they need to switch.  For example, if there is a meter at school and another at the grandparents'.

### Describe the solution you'd like
It will be great if both meters can be linked at the same time so that there will be no need for additional scanning.

### Describe alternatives you've considered
Scan and link every time there is a need to use a different meter.

comments.body: Maybe, we should generalize the support of multiple Bluetooth devices. Then, more than one insulin pen like Inpen or newer smartpens can be supported.
Also, do you have a list of Bluetooth glucometers you plan to support?
I would just like to allow more than 1 meter to be linked at the same time.  I was not going to edit the list.

> I would just like to allow more than 1 meter to be linked at the same time. I was not going to edit the list.

Is there a documented list of supported glucometers?
